name: Bubble sort
title: Bubble sort
sub: Repeatedly swap adjacent out-of-order pairs; the largest value bubbles to the end each pass.

workflow.label: Build & verify › handle the edge cases

params.label: early exit
params.hint: On = stop as soon as a full pass makes no swaps (already sorted). Off = always run every pass.

code: if not swapped: break       // early exit

questions.text: For nearly-sorted input, is the early-exit check worth one extra comparison per pass?
